title: config/generated.json
description: The generated-file rule of AGENTS.md, read by generated-files.mts: a staged or tracked path that a glob of paths matches is refused, and so is a tracked text file whose header matches a pattern of headers; an exception glob accepts it again. kit sets no generated folder, header or module file of its own (K1105).

paths.description: Globs of repository paths that are generated, such as **/node_modules/** or a build output folder of the repository; they are the only generated paths. Read by picomatch with dot: true.

tracked.description: Generated sources that a consumer installs as the tagged tree itself, such as a Go module or a Rust crate: each glob of repository paths is tracked in Git, and its reason says why; the directory of each glob, or one of its parents, holds a file that moduleFiles names (P34). Read by picomatch with dot: true.

headers.description: Regular expressions of a generated-file header, such as Code generated .* DO NOT EDIT: tracked refuses a text file whose first comment line among its first five lines matches one (K426, K1105). None declared, no header is checked.

moduleFiles.description: The file names that make a directory a tagged-tree module for the tracked entries, such as go.mod and Cargo.toml (P34, K1105). None declared, the directory of a tracked entry is not checked.

exceptions.description: Generated segments that the repository keeps, each glob of repository paths with its reason, such as test fixtures: read by picomatch with dot: true. A glob names one deliberate file set, never a whole generated folder; an exception exempts the path from the generated-file and duplication checks (K958).
